features: Explicit direct IPv4 candidate search without Tor/Snowflake
Separate TCP-only and identity-verified HTTPS results
Offline presets, bounded CIDR samples and retested local success cache
Cancellation on dismissal/background/network change; no browser route change

native_probe.scope: Local obfs4/WebTunnel native listeners; not integrated into browser

known_limitations: Not a general proxy or guaranteed Internet gateway
IPv4 only; large ranges are sampled, not exhaustively scanned
An HTTP status does not prove full site, video or other-host availability
No routing of browser traffic through discovered IPs in this version
A complete disconnection or source-access whitelist is not bypassed by address search
next_steps: Complete build, unit, Android, TLS validation, cancellation and 0.11-to-0.12 upgrade checks
Sign ARM64 release with unchanged private key outside CI
Deliver scanner and explain results in a short phone test
